name: resource-monitor-ng
description: Ultra-lightweight, zero-overhead Linux & macOS Apple Silicon resource monitor for VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Resource Monitor: Toggle Tooltip Mode (Static / Live)
Resource Monitor: Toggle Static Tooltip Auto-Refresh
Resource Monitor: Toggle CPU Tooltip Layout (Table / List)
Resource Monitor: Toggle System Load Format (Percent / Value)
Resource Monitor: Toggle Multi-Disk Display Mode (All / MostFull)

resmon.show.cpuusage.description: Toggles the display of CPU usage percentage.

resmon.show.cpufreq.description: Toggles the display of CPU frequency (Linux) or system load average (macOS).

resmon.show.cputemp.description: Toggles the display of CPU temperature.

resmon.show.mem.description: Toggles the display of memory consumption.

resmon.show.battery.description: Toggles the display of battery percentage remaining.

resmon.show.disk.description: Toggles the display of disk space information.

resmon.show.settings.description: Shows the settings (gear) widget after the metrics: its tooltip holds the quick toggles, a click opens the settings panel.

resmon.order.description: Left-to-right order of the status bar widgets: cpu (CPU usage), freq (CPU frequency on Linux, system load on macOS), temp, mem, battery, disk. Missing entries keep their default position.

resmon.disk.format.description: Format for displaying disk space information.

resmon.disk.drives.description: Specific mount paths to monitor. If empty, monitors the workspace root or '/'.

resmon.disk.multiDisplay.description: Multi-disk status bar display mode: 'All' displays compact metrics for all monitored disks; 'MostFull' displays only the single volume with highest utilization.

resmon.updatefrequencyms.description: Status bar interval in milliseconds (200-15000). It is the clock of the extension: in Live mode tooltips follow every tick, and per-section refresh intervals shorter than it take effect once per tick.

resmon.priority.description: Base priority for status bar positioning. Higher values place it further to the left; lower or negative values place it further to the right.

resmon.tooltip.mode.description: Tooltip refresh mode: 'Static' regenerates tooltips on click and, when auto-refresh is on, at the per-section intervals of 'resmon.refreshMs' (limits hover flicker); 'Live' regenerates them on every status bar tick ('resmon.updatefrequencyms'). Each tooltip shows the time of its last update (with tenths of a second below 1000 ms).

resmon.tooltip.autoRefresh.description: Static mode only: automatically regenerate tooltips at the per-section intervals of 'resmon.refreshMs'. When off, Static tooltips refresh only on click.

freq.description: CPU frequency (Linux) / system load (macOS): Static tooltip refresh (ms).

temp.description: Temperature: sampling and Static tooltip refresh (ms; minimum 2000: on macOS each sensor pass costs ~16 ms of HID IPC).

battery.description: Battery: sampling and Static tooltip refresh (ms; minimum 2000 unless resmon.allowFastBatteryDiskRefresh is on).

disk.description: Disk: sampling and Static tooltip refresh (ms; minimum 2000 unless resmon.allowFastBatteryDiskRefresh is on).

resmon.refreshMs.description: Refresh interval in milliseconds for each section (200 ms to 1 h). In Static mode it is the tooltip auto-refresh interval (see 'resmon.tooltip.autoRefresh'); battery, disk and temperature are also sampled at this interval in both modes. Intervals shorter than 'resmon.updatefrequencyms' take effect at the next status bar tick.

resmon.allowFastBatteryDiskRefresh.markdownDescription: **Performance impact.** Allows battery and disk refresh below 2000 ms (down to 200 ms). Each battery read queries IOPowerSources/IOKit and each disk read calls `statfs`: below 2 s this costs CPU time and energy for values that change slowly. Off by default; values set below 2000 ms are kept and apply again when this is turned on.

resmon.refreshSeconds.deprecationMessage: Replaced by resmon.refreshMs (milliseconds). Still read, converted, until resmon.refreshMs is set.
resmon.refreshSeconds.description: Deprecated: per-section refresh in seconds. Use resmon.refreshMs.

resmon.tooltip.cpuLayout.description: Layout style for CPU per-core breakdown in tooltips: 'Table' for compact side-by-side grid; 'List' for vertical cluster sections.

resmon.loadFormat.description: Format for displaying System Load Average on Darwin: 'Percent' (normalized capacity across available cores) or 'Value' (raw POSIX queue depth).
